pa6dbeb.observed: Run in work/probe/pa6dbeb with all 13 probe inputs on legalMoves, status and applyMove(f,'e2e4'). No argument, undefined, null, 42: all three throw Error 'Invalid FEN: expected a string'. '' and 'not-a-fen': Error 'Invalid FEN: expected 6 fields, got 1'. 7 ranks: Error 'Invalid FEN: expected 8 ranks, got 7'. Side 'x': Error 'Invalid FEN: active color must be w or b'. Also bad castling field, bad en-passant field, counter 'x', rank of 7 squares, rank '9', unknown letter: each a descriptive 'Invalid FEN: ...' Error. startFen()+'\n' tolerated (20 moves, ongoing, e2e4 gives the correct FEN). Impossible positions return values: no kings -> [] / 'stalemate' / IllegalMoveError; two white kings -> 8 moves / ongoing; pawn on 8th -> 3 moves / ongoing; side not to move in check -> 16 moves / ongoing / applyMove e2e4 returns '4k3/8/8/8/4R3/8/8/4K3 b - - 1 1'. Consistent across the three functions; no hangs.

pc62f4b.observed: Run in work/probe/pc62f4b with the same inputs. No argument/undefined/null: TypeError "Cannot read properties of undefined/null (reading 'trim')"; 42: TypeError 'fen.trim is not a function'; '', 'not-a-fen', 7 ranks: TypeError 'ranks[rank] is not iterable' (internal, not descriptive). Side 'x' (malformed): confident wrong answer, legalMoves [] and status 'stalemate', applyMove IllegalMoveError. Extra malformed inputs also accepted silently: castling 'XYZ' -> 20 moves/ongoing; en-passant 'z9' -> 20 moves/ongoing; a rank '7' (7 squares) -> 20 moves/ongoing; rank '9' -> applyMove returns 'rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/97/8/...'; unknown letter 'x' -> 20 moves and applyMove echoes 'ppppxppp'. Counter 'x' -> SyntaxError 'Cannot convert x to a BigInt'. Trailing newline tolerated. Impossible positions return values identical to the other products (no kings -> stalemate, etc.). No hangs, but several malformed FENs get confident wrong answers, which the inventory calls not fine.
